newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Banco Ganadero proposes 14 peso dividend.
newsitem.headline: Banco Ganadero proposes 14 peso dividend.

text.p: Colombia's Banco Ganadero said it would propose at a shareholders' meeting on March 6 that the bank pay 1996 dividends of 43.09 billion pesos, based on earnings for the year of 56.49 billion pesos.

Payment of an annual cash dividend of 14 pesos per share -- pertaining to the 479.76 million preferred shares and 2.311 billion common shares issued before January 1996 --- would be made in four quarterly payments, the bank said in a statement issued simultaneously in New York and Bogota.
Total dividend payments to holders of these shares will be 39.08 billion pesos, the statement said, adding that the 14 peso per share dividend represents a 21.7 percent increase over 1995.

It said payment of a 14 peso per share dividend pertaining to 831.52 million common shares issued on August 27, 1996, when Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya acquired a 40 percent stake in Ganadero's voting stock, would be calculated on a prorated basis from that date through December 31, 1996, in four quarterly payments. This dividend will also be voted on at the shareholders meeting.
Ganadero is Colombia's largest bank in terms of assets. Its 1996 earnings were up 6 percent over 1995.
